card.name: Start of capitalized proper names
card.fires_on: The first letters of a proper name or place name split into pieces, such as L in Llano, K in Koonwarra, G in Gaspésie, or Gre in Greer. It fires mostly in lists, citations and place or plant names.

modes.label: Place and plant names
modes.description: The opening piece of a rare place name or local plant name in a list or citation.

modes.label: Surnames
modes.description: The first piece of a person's surname, often in author or book credits.

modes.label: Stray linking words
modes.description: Occasional small linking words before an unusual continuation.

card.writes: It pushes down the likelihood of non-English name pieces such as dé, пр and prz, and slightly favors words like override and exceed.
card.plain: It marks the first piece of an unusual name that is about to be spelled out in several parts.
